screen.phones.title: From your phones
screen.phones.cameIn.title: What came in
phones.row.hint: Calendar and health your phones bring
phones.lead: What your phones bring to this computer. Your phones read it; nothing here changes it on the phone.
phones.browser.note: A phone in the browser can’t bring its calendar or health. The Nocturne app can.
phones.calendar.label: Calendar
phones.calendar.summary: {count, plural, one {# calendar} other {# calendars}} · last came in {time}
phones.calendar.upcoming: {count, plural, one {# appointment} other {# appointments}} in the next two weeks
phones.calendar.seeCameIn.named: See what came in from {phone}’s calendar
phones.health.label: Health
phones.noticing.label: Notice what goes together
phones.noticing.hint: A sentence in your recaps when sleep, steps or workouts went with something in your journal, with its receipts.
phones.delete.hint: From the calendar, from Health, or both.
phones.page.heading: On your page
phones.page.calendar.label: Your calendar today
phones.page.calendar.hint: What’s on today, from every phone that brings its calendar.
phones.page.sleep.label: Sleep last night
phones.page.sleep.hint: One line under the page’s title, once the night has come in. Never read aloud.
phones.foot: Calendar and health come only through Away from home, in locked messages. Nothing else is downloaded or sent.
phones.empty: No phone has brought its calendar or health yet.
phones.failed: That didn’t go through. Nothing was changed.
phones.cameIn.title: Calendar from {phone}
phones.cameIn.lead: Newest change first. Each one opens its own page.
phones.cameIn.empty: Nothing has come in from {phone} yet.
phones.cameIn.unknown: That phone isn’t paired any more.
phones.stop.body: What already came in stays. {phone} is told next time it connects, and stops sending.
phones.delete.lead: It goes from this computer for good.
phones.delete.rows.calendar: {count, plural, one {# appointment} other {# appointments}} from {phone}’s calendar, and their earlier versions
phones.delete.rows.health: {count, plural, one {# reading} other {# readings}} of {kinds} from {phone}
phones.delete.lines.calendar: {count, plural, one {# line on your past pages cites them and will say (forgotten).} other {# lines on your past pages cite them and will say (forgotten).}}
phones.delete.lines.health: {count, plural, one {# line in your reflections and recaps cites them and will be taken out.} other {# lines in your reflections and recaps cite them and will be taken out.}}
phones.delete.noticing: {count, plural, one {# sentence about what went together will be worked out again.} other {# sentences about what went together will be worked out again.}}
phones.delete.alsoStop: Also stop taking the calendar from {phone}
phones.delete.alsoStop.hint: If you leave this off, the next two weeks come back the next time {phone} sends.
phones.delete.untouched.health: Health on your phone isn’t touched. Readings you delete here aren’t sent again.
phones.delete.error: Nocturne couldn’t get the list ready. Nothing has been deleted.
phones.delete.refreshed: That list was out of date, so Nocturne refreshed it. Check it, then delete.
phones.remove.adds: Calendar entries and health readings it brought stay too. To delete them, use {fromYourPhones}.
phones.delete.shared: {count, plural, one {# thing Nocturne learned also comes from something you kept. It stays; only the phone’s receipt goes.} other {# things Nocturne learned also come from things you kept. They stay; only the phone’s receipt goes.}}
